subject: Run-rate scenarios & finance ask: closing the Q3 coverage shortfall
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@horizontech.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@broadpath.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Run-rate scenarios & finance ask: closing the Q3 coverage shortfall

Sara / Tom —

Quick update and an ask from finance before Friday: our Q3 planning shows a ~22% shortfall vs. the committed coverage target for the US mid-market book. I attached an XLS with three run-rate scenarios (base / accelerated / aggressive) and the assumptions for each.

High level: if we (1) get stage movement on 4 deals listed on tab "QuickClose" and (2) secure two incremental PO/letters of intent that are in late eval, the accelerated scenario gets us within 5% of target. Without staged updates and firm commit signals, we expect a shortfall that will impact headcount and spending conversations next week.

Ask: can your team confirm by EOD Friday which of the Horizon Health line items you can (a) move to Closed-Won in July, or (b) provide a firm written commitment (PO/LoI) for August? If neither, please indicate realistic next-close month. Finance needs these dates to finalize the runway model.

I've looped in Marissa and Laura for deal-level hygiene (stage cleanses and backup backup plans), and Aditya for quick numbers we can feed into the FP&A sheet. If helpful we can run a 30-min scenario walk-through tomorrow.

Attachments: Q3_run_rate_scenarios.xlsx (models + quick-close tab), MOP_revision_v2.pdf (updated BOT/qualification criteria)

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales, US Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@horizontech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@broadpath.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-rate scenarios & finance ask: closing the Q3 coverage shortfall

Karthik —

Thanks for the transparency and the model. We reviewed the QuickClose tab and can confirm the following:
- Horizon Health: can provide a signed LoI for the pilot (3 hospitals) by 07/22; procurement timeline pushes final PO to mid-August.
- We cannot accelerate the evaluation cycle for the telemetry piece due to an internal security review that completes 7/30.

We can join a 30-min walk-through tomorrow at 10:00 PT to align on assumptions. Filing a note to ops-finance@acme.com (cc'd) to indicate the LoI plan.

—Sara
Director, Digital Transformation
Horizon Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@horizontech.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@broadpath.io>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-rate scenarios & finance ask: closing the Q3 coverage shortfall

Looping in the quick hygiene outputs after a fast scrub of our CRM and the attached model. Key notes:
- QuickClose candidates (from our win likelihood & licencing checks): 4 deals that we can try to push now — details in the XLS, tab 'QuickClose'. I flagged reps and next action.
- Two opportunities (OPP-4592, OPP-4610) have procurement blockers: both require SOC evidence and a short security checklist. I added a note -> reach out to Security with a targeted ask to speed reviews.
- For three other deals (OPP-4550, OPP-4471, OPP-4638), we have legal hold-ups on contract language (data retention SLA). If Legal can approve a limited amendment, those can close in July.

Immediate asks for reps (please call out in your 1:1s today):
1) Update stage to Negotiation/Final where you have verbal sign-off; add expected PO month in the close date field.
2) For anything with >70% win likelihood but missing SOC evidence, document the exact compliance ask and tag security@redwood.com.
3) Confirm if procurement will accept LoI vs PO for revenue recognition triggers (we are asking Finance for a narrow exception if SoP allows).

I ran a delta calc — moving the QuickClose four deals from Negotiation to Closed-Won by 7/31 shifts our base scenario by +12% coverage. Two additional LOIs push us into the accelerated band. See attached.

-Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Run-rate scenarios & finance ask: closing the Q3 coverage shortfall

Team —

Thanks Marissa for the scrub. Two quick directives from GTM leadership:
1) All reps on mid-market must update stage and put a conservative close month (no blank dates) by EOD Wednesday 7/16. We will not accept vague "Q3" dates — pick the month.
2) Reps with deals flagged for SOC/legal: attach the exact ask and the contact at the customer's side in the CRM as a note. This will let Security and Legal triage immediately.

Aditya — please provide the three-run-rate outputs (base / accelerated / aggressive) as a single table for Finance by 7/16 noon so FP&A can run the headcount sensitivity model. Karthik, I want a short 20-min alignment after we collect updates on 7/16 at 2:00 PM PT.

Laura
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Run-rate scenarios & finance ask: closing the Q3 coverage shortfall — action summary

Team / Sara —

Thanks for the quick responses and the commitment on the LoI. Summary of agreed actions and owners (please reply with any corrections):
- Horizon Health (Sara): LoI by 07/22; PO expected mid-August. Marked in XLS.
- Reps (owners in CRM flagged by Marissa): update stages and populate explicit close month by 07/16 EOD. (Owner: individual SDR/AEs)
- Security/Legal blockers (Marissa -> security@redwood.com / legal@redwood.com): provide exact evidence checklist; Marissa to escalate for two procurement-blocked opps.
- Aditya: deliver consolidated three-scenario table for Finance by 07/16 12:00 PT.
- Karthik/Laura: alignment 07/16 14:00 PT to review updates and finalize FP&A inputs.

If we can hit the stage updates and the Horizon LoI cadence, our base-to-accelerated delta closes most of the gap; finance will still run the sensitivity table to confirm headcount impacts. If anything slips, we'll prepare an exception request for limited recognition options (LOI-based) and an ask to Finance for a short-term cost mitigate.

I'll send a calendar brief with the 20-min alignment.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales, US Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
